paragraphs: Rav (or Mar) Natan bar Asya, [Pesachim 50a (52a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.52a.2-3).[^1]

notes.text: The named account at 52a has Rav Natan bar Asya and gives alternate accounts of his punishment. [Heilprin’s Asya entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=629&lang=en) also has Rav. Hyman supplies the alternative title Mar and the locator 50a.
